
```{r}
#| label: __DIFFCHUNKLABEL__
#| results: asis
#| fig-height: 3.6
if (exists("ga") && !is.null(ga) && nrow(ga) > 0) {
  chans <- dat %>% filter(window == "__WINDOW_R__") %>% distinct(channel) %>% pull(channel)
  d <- ga %>% filter(bin %in% c("__BIN1_R__", "__BIN2_R__"), channel %in% chans) %>%
       select(grand_average, channel, time_ms, bin, amplitude) %>%
       pivot_wider(names_from = bin, values_from = amplitude)
  if (all(c("__BIN1_R__", "__BIN2_R__") %in% names(d))) {
    d$diff <- d[["__BIN2_R__"]] - d[["__BIN1_R__"]]
    # sd() of a single value is NA, so with one grand average -- the
    # ordinary case -- there is no band to draw at all, and n_ga records
    # how many there were so the absence is explicable rather than odd.
    ds <- d %>% group_by(channel, time_ms) %>%
          summarise(m = mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE),
                    n_ga = sum(!is.na(diff)),
                    se = if (sum(!is.na(diff)) > 1)
                           sd(diff, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(diff)))
                         else NA_real_,
                    .groups = "drop")
    win <- dat %>% filter(window == "__WINDOW_R__") %>%
           summarise(lo = suppressWarnings(min(window_start_ms, na.rm = TRUE)),
                     hi = suppressWarnings(max(window_stop_ms, na.rm = TRUE)))
    q <- ggplot(ds, aes(x = time_ms, y = m))
    if (is.finite(win$lo) && is.finite(win$hi)) {
      q <- q + annotate("rect", xmin = win$lo, xmax = win$hi, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
                        alpha = 0.12, fill = "grey30")
    }
    q <- q +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey60") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey60") +
      {if (any(is.finite(ds$se)))
         geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = m - se, ymax = m + se), alpha = 0.2, fill = "steelblue")
       else NULL} +
      geom_line(colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
      facet_wrap(~ channel) +
      labs(x = "time (ms)", y = "difference (µV)") +
      alz_theme()
    print(q)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```
